79148.subject: Ethena Pay’s Edge
79148.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

Hi all, happy Tuesday! Crypto rallied on Monday before reversing overnight as optimism around the CLARITY Act faded ahead of today’s Senate vote. We also examine Ethena Pay’s revenue model and what its launch, alongside the approved fee switch, could mean for ENA.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

Crypto started the week higher across 22 of 25 indices at the end of Monday’s UTC session. BTC gained 2.2%, the S&P 500 added 1.0% and the Nasdaq rose 1.4%, while gold fell 1.1%. Privacy (6.9%), DEXs (6.3%) and Low Revenue, High FDV (5.6%) led, while Bittensor Ecosystem (-3.6%), Meme (-1.7%) and Crypto Miners (-1.0%) were the only decliners.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/b0d7ccda-d366-45ed-96c7-48cfdf2e48c8/image.png?t=1789476755)
Caption: 

At 2:15pm ET, the Senate votes on cloture on the motion to proceed to the CLARITY Act, a procedural step requiring 60 votes. Republicans hold 53 seats, so at least seven Democrats or independents would need to support the motion, with any Republican defections raising that threshold. Yesterday’s newsletter covered the ethics concession intended to secure that support, but [opposition has since hardened](https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-09-14-where-the-clarity-act-stands-ahead-of-tuesdays-senate-vote-414720). 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/3657e3d3-1a33-4469-a7e5-adc4a1f4101b/image.png?t=1789476755)
Caption: 

[Polymarket’s implied probability of the CLARITY Act being signed into law this year](https://polymarket.com/event/clarity-act-signed-into-law-in-2026) rose from 22% to 34% within two hours of Sunday night’s revised text and held near 30% through much of Monday. BTC followed higher, rising over $79k by 2pm ET. 

Later in the day, [Warren rejected the revised ethics language](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/warren-clarity-act-senate-key-preliminary-vote.html), Van Hollen restated his opposition, and eight banking groups criticized the stablecoin circuit breaker. Democrats then [submitted a counterproposal](https://www.coindesk.com/policy/2026/09/15/democrats-send-counteroffer-to-republicans-over-clarity-act-provisions) to a text Republicans had called final. By 7pm ET, enactment odds had fallen to 16.5%. BTC also reversed, falling 2.8% from its afternoon high to $76.97k overnight.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Crypto is on hold for the Senate's CLARITY Act cloture vote as Democrats counter a Trump-backed ethics deal. Bitcoin cools near $77K while Washington pushes crypto tax rules and sanctions enforcement. 🏛️ Democrats Send Counteroffer Hours Before CLARITY Act Cloture Vote Senate Democrats delivered a counterproposal to Republicans late Monday, a day after GOP negotiators released a “final” CLARITY Act draft with ethics restrictions President Trump agreed to accept. Democrats still object that state attorneys general could not sue the president directly and that ethics officials could grant waivers for crypto business ties. The procedural vote, which needs 60 senators, is set for 2:15 p.m. ET today. Read full story 📉 Bitcoin Retreats From $79.5K as Traders Brace for Senate Vote Bitcoin slipped to roughly $77,400 in European hours, giving back about 3% from an overnight peak near $79,530 and trading lower on the week. XRP bucked the trend with a gain of more than 2% to $1.41, while zcash rose nearly 3%. A Siebert Financial analyst argued the market may be overestimating how much the vote’s outcome matters. More details ⚖️ DOJ Moves to Seize $61M in Crypto Tied to Iranian Oil Sales Federal prosecutors in New York filed a civil forfeiture complaint targeting $61 million in crypto allegedly linked to Iran’s black-market oil trade and the IRGC. The funds are described as part of a $1.5 billion pipeline routed through unhosted wallets, with two Chinese firms allegedly using Binance accounts to launder proceeds. Binance said it does not permit transactions with sanctioned parties and is cooperating with authorities. Read more 🧾 House Panel Unveils 114-Page Crypto Tax Bill Ahead of Markup The House Ways and Means Committee released the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, covering de minimis transactions, wash sales, mining, staking and broker rules. It would exempt network or transaction fees under $10 from tax, excluding anyone with more than 5,000 transfers in the prior year. The committee votes on Sept. 16, though enactment this year looks unlikely.
